function.description: Get ranked Jupiter Prediction traders by period and metric (PnL, volume, or win rate) — use solana.predict.profile instead for one trader's own stats rather than a ranked comparison. realizedPnlUsd/totalVolumeUsd fields are exact-decimal USD strings with raw *Micro siblings. Note: each row's winRatePct is unit-unconfirmed (no fixture/doc has confirmed its scale) — treat it as an unverified figure, not a settled percent.
function.name: solana__predict__leaderboards

metric.description: Ranking metric: pnl, volume, or win_rate.
